typography.guidelines: Headings must use Chivo with tight tracking (tracking-tight). All tabular data, numbers, KPIs, and status indicators MUST use IBM Plex Mono for perfect column alignment and the 'terminal' feel. Do not use Inter for headings.

layout_spacing.strategy: Dense, modular grid. 'Control Room' protocol for the dashboard. Use generous spacing (p-12 to p-24) on the marketing landing page, but strict, compact spacing (p-4 to p-6) on the app dashboard.
layout_spacing.dashboard_grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or up to 12-col grids. No soft drop shadows; use 1px solid borders (border-border).
layout_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px-4px). Sharp corners emphasize the precision and rigor of the finance domain.

components.cards: Flat, no shadows, 1px solid border (#27272A). Background is pure surface color (#121212).
components.buttons: Primary: Flat amber background (#FF8C00) with black text. Secondary: Transparent with 1px border. Hover states: Lighter amber or background color change.
components.tables: First-class citizens. Dense rows, monospace font for numbers, right-aligned for financial metrics, 1px borders separating rows.
components.terminal_motifs: Include a ticker-style status bar at the top or bottom of the dashboard. Use blinking cursor animations (via CSS keyframes) in the search bar or command palette.

icons.guidelines: Use dense dashboards and developer tools optimized icons. Weight should be regular or bold depending on emphasis. No soft/rounded icons.

hero_bg.description: Abstract dark architectural blueprint intersecting with glowing amber financial data streams, 3D render, dark mode background. Use in landing page hero section behind a dark gradient overlay (bg-black/60).

document_audit.description: Macro close-up of a legal financial document with glowing orange highlights and data extraction brackets. Use for the PDF Drag-and-drop feature section or deal detail page on the landing site.

data_viz.description: High-end 3D rendering of complex financial charts and data nodes in deep charcoal and bright amber orange. Use for the 'Analytics/Financial Extract' features section.

market_chart_1.description: Stock market candlestick chart on dark screen. Good for secondary feature visuals or background texture in the dashboard.

motion.hover: Instant or very fast transitions (150ms). Finance professionals prefer speed over floaty animations.
motion.terminal: Blinking cursor for command lines (animate-pulse). Ticker tape animations for real-time market data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme (Bloomberg terminal inspired) using #0A0A0A background and #FF8C00 (Amber) accent.
Use Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Mono for all data/tables. Use Inter only for standard body text.
Do not use card shadows (shadow-sm, etc.). Rely on 1px solid borders (border-[#27272A]) for layout separation.
For the Landing Page, implement a hero section with the `hero_bg` image, heavily overlayed with bg-black/70. Do not center everything; use aggressive asymmetrical grid layouts.
Use typographic logos for trusted banks (e.g., 'LAZARD', 'EVERCORE', 'CENTERVIEW') in muted mono font instead of generic placeholder images.
Implement a command-palette style search or input on the dashboard.
For the dashboard grid, use dense layouts: 'Control Room' protocol. Utilize all available space efficiently.
All tabular data must be perfectly aligned (numbers right-aligned) and use monospace fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-pdf-dropzone').
No purple gradients. No rounded corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
Avoid glassmorphism for widgets. Use solid dark backgrounds with crisp borders for maximum data clarity.
